# Orbit

> A typed, non-Turing-complete, HTML-strict template language for storefronts,
> content sites, and anywhere templates are authored by people — or models — you
> do not fully trust. XSS is a compile error, resource exhaustion is a budget
> trip, and the data a template can touch is statically extractable.

Several constructs that are ordinary in other template languages do not exist
in Orbit, and reaching for them produces code that does not compile. The rules
that most often surprise:

- `<if>` requires a `Bool`. There is no truthiness.
- A `T?` value must be given `??` or narrowed with `!= none` before use.
- Only allowlisted HTML. No `<script>`, no `on*` handlers, no `<iframe>`.
- `style` attributes must be fully static.
- No method calls (`{x |> upper}`, not `{x.upper()}`) and no dynamic member access.
- `<for>` requires an `<empty>` block as its last child.
- `|>` is the LOOSEST operator, so a comparison after a pipeline needs parentheses.

## Generating Orbit

- [System prompt](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/llm/system-prompt.md): paste into a model's system prompt. Dense, rule-shaped, states the failure modes.
- [Eval harness](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/llm/eval/): measures generate → compile → repair success. Runs offline.

## Documentation

- [tutorial](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/docs/language/tutorial.md): Your first component, end to end.
- [safety](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/docs/language/safety.md): The two rules that cause most first-hour errors: no truthiness, and the optional law.
- [templates](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/docs/language/templates.md): Markup rules: the closed element allowlist, attributes, whitespace, RCDATA, JSON-LD.
- [components](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/docs/language/components.md): Components vs pages, props, slots, <let>, settings.
- [types](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/docs/language/types.md): The type system, including the branded terminal types.
- [grammar](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/docs/reference/grammar.md): Full grammar and operator precedence.
- [filters](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/docs/reference/filters.md): All 19 stdlib filters with signatures and limitations.
- [limits](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/docs/reference/limits.md): Every cap, its value, and the diagnostic it trips.
- [errors](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/docs/reference/errors.md): Every diagnostic code, generated from source.
- [embedding](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/docs/guides/embedding.md): Implementing a host: types, filters, stored ASTs, access plans.
- [security-model](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/docs/guides/security-model.md): Threat model, each guarantee and its mechanism, and what Orbit does NOT protect against.
- [custom-properties](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/docs/design/custom-properties.md):
- [widgets](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/docs/design/widgets.md):
- [closed-world](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/docs/evaluation/closed-world.md):
- [non-js-embedding](https://github.com/princesourav/orbit-lang/blob/main/docs/guides/non-js-embedding.md):
